killedBy: the outbound legal links is a link, opens safely, and says so in its name
why: `target="_blank"` without `rel="noopener"` gives the opened page a live `window.opener` back into the game, and without `noreferrer` it sends the game's URL along. The only two outbound links in the application are these, so this is the whole of the app's external-link posture. Nothing observable changes: the link still opens the right page in a new tab, so no behavioural assertion anywhere else can distinguish it.
